Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with Universalis and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.32

- Ask before raising existing listing prices, with optional remembered Yes/No choices and a Settings reset.
- Add optional detailed automatic listing-selector logs to investigate failed first attempts and successful retries without changing listing behavior.
